description: PR #1541 merged with active_bytes=16088 against a 16000 budget. The guard runs as both a pre-commit hook and a CI lint step, yet develop ended up in a state its own guard rejects - so every subsequent commit in every worktree aborted and every open PR failed, independent of content. Fixed the symptom in PR #1544 by compressing the corpus back to 15993. The unanswered question is how it merged: either the lint job did not run the check on that PR, or it ran against a different file set than the hook does. Until that is known the same class recurs on the next byte-adding merge, and the failure mode is repo-wide. Note the failure is also easy to misread: the pre-commit abort leaves the branch pushable, so a commit that never happened looks like a successful push.

work_units.evidence: PR 1541 CI tested synthetic merge fea61e4 against base d1f7cbcd at active_bytes=15947. PR 1539 then advanced develop to active_bytes=15990 before PR 1541 merged; its 98-byte delta produced active_bytes=16088. Live ruleset 15611785 has strict_required_status_checks_policy=false, so stale green checks remained merge-eligible.
work_units.summary: Reconstruct PR 1541 tested merge, concurrent develop merges, and final budget state

work_units.evidence: Runbook now requires strict current-base checks and explains concurrency tradeoff; drift fixtures and parser assertions pin develop strict=true. 41 focused tests pass; live negative control fails only because ruleset 15611785 remains false.
work_units.summary: Pin strict current-base required checks in the ruleset runbook and drift tests

work_units.evidence: Updated live develop ruleset 15611785 on 2026-08-13 to strict_required_status_checks_policy=true while preserving all other rules; API verification confirms required contexts ci-required-result and Results Explorer browser gate, zero bypass actors, linear history, non-fast-forward, and deletion protection. PR #1708 worktree live drift check passed with only the pre-existing non-blocking v-tag bypass confirmation advisory.
work_units.summary: Apply strict current-base policy to the live develop ruleset and confirm drift parity
